title: Keep or Roll Back? Out-of-Loop Judges for Self-Improving VLA and End-to-End Embodied Policies
abstract: arXiv:2611.33794v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-improvement is now a practical recipe for embodied policies: a policy collects experience, is retrained, and is kept when a judge rates it higher. However, the judge is usually trained or chosen inside the same loop, so its evidence is not independent of the policy. We introduce SealedLoop, an evaluation framework that adds a sealed judge: an evaluator outside the loop that the improver cannot see or optimize against. A new policy is kept only when a sequential test on the sealed judge confirms the gain, with a bounded probability of keeping a worse one. Running the same loop under each judge, we separate two sources of a false gain, which we call judge error (the loop's judge is wrong on its own data) and transfer gap (a real gain there does not carry over to unseen conditions). We evaluate on LIBERO manipulation, NAVSIM driving, and a full-scale real vehicle. In manipulation, a success classifier accepted 65 of 196 failures in one

translated_title: 保留还是回滚？面向自改进VLA与端到端具身策略的循环外裁判
translated_abstract: 自改进如今已成为具身策略的实用方案：策略收集经验、被重新训练，并在裁判评定其更优时被保留。然而，裁判通常是在同一循环内被训练或选择的，因此其证据并非独立于策略本身。我们提出了SealedLoop，这是一个引入“密封裁判”的评估框架：该评估器位于循环之外，改进者既无法看到它，也无法针对它进行优化。只有当密封裁判上的序贯检验确认了性能提升时，新策略才会被保留，且保留更差策略的概率是有界的。在每个裁判下运行相同的循环，我们区分了虚假提升的两个来源：一是“裁判误差”（循环内裁判在其自身数据上判断错误），二是“迁移差距”（在该处的真实提升无法迁移到未见过的条件下）。我们在LIBERO操作、NAVSIM驾驶以及一辆全尺寸真实车辆上进行了评估。在操作任务中，一个成功分类器在196个失败中接受了65个（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出SealedLoop评估框架，将“密封裁判”置于策略自改进循环之外，通过序贯检验以有界错误率确认性能提升，并将虚假提升区分为裁判误差与迁移差距两类来源。
en_tdlr: SealedLoop introduces an out-of-loop "sealed judge" with sequential testing to validate self-improvement gains of embodied policies with bounded error probability, separating false gains into judge error and transfer gap.
